svg.title: One day, round the loop
svg.desc: Six moments in one day. On a morning walk you ask what is pressing, and Claude tells you from the folder. Forty minutes later a decision is made out loud and Claude writes a return. About three minutes later the back end, scripts with no AI, has filed it. The agent's next session in the project starts from a brief of what is waiting, with your question in it. When the agent is stuck, its question is filed as critical and a push reaches your phone. Your next walk opens with that question, and your answer goes back the same way.
svg.text: One day, round the loop
What you work out on a walk is filed. Agents on
the project start from it, and ask you back.
YOU · A MORNING WALK
“What's pressing?”
Claude opens the folder and tells you: a
decision due Friday, and an agent that is
blocked on a question.
YOU · FORTY MINUTES LATER
The decision is made, out loud
Claude writes a return: what you decided,
and two new questions, one for the agent.
THE BACK END · ABOUT THREE MINUTES
Filed, with no AI involved
Scripts apply the return: the item is settled,
the new ones get numbers, and the front
page of the agenda is rebuilt.
AN AGENT · ITS NEXT SESSION
It starts from the agenda
A brief shows your question, and what is
due, before it plans anything.
THE AGENT · WHEN IT IS STUCK
Its question comes to you
Filed as critical, naming the work that waits.
One push reaches your phone.
YOU · THE NEXT WALK
The talk opens with that question
Your answer goes back the same way.
Today you start each agent session yourself.
